verdict.rationale: Productboard docs explicitly describe rescheduling initiatives and moving them between releases, both via the product and via its MCP server/API (e.g., 'reschedule an initiative' and 'move an initiative to a new release'), directly matching the story. This is native roadmap/release management functionality reinforced by API-level control, though there's no independent hands-on validation of the UI workflow itself. Missing for 10: independent/third-party confirmation of the release-reassignment UI in practice, and more detail on how release timelines are visualized/updated.
